note: Fla. Admin. Code r. 68B-20.003(2)(d) jetty buffers, read structure by structure on USGS NAIP imagery. The rule is 100 ft from the unsubmerged portion of a jetty; every buffer is drawn at 150 ft. kind closed: an inlet or fishing jetty. kind warn: a shore structure that may count as a jetty (groin, breakwater, revetment, detached breakwater). Built by tools/build-jetties.py.
